verdict.rationale: HubSpot documents creating contact records through the API (POST /crm/v3/objects/contacts) and an official MCP server that gives any MCP-compatible agent read and write access to CRM data, so an agent can create the lead record. The other two steps of the story are not evidenced: nothing shows filling or enriching company data via API/MCP, and nothing shows assigning an owner. missing for 10: documented company-data enrichment or company association via API/MCP, documented owner-assignment via API/MCP, an end-to-end agent enrichment workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent enrich a new lead end-to-end via the API or MCP server — creating the record, filling company data, and assigning an owner

citations.quote: To create one contact, make a `POST` request to `/crm/v3/objects/contacts`.
The HubSpot MCP server enables you to give any MCP-compatible AI tool or agent secure read and write access to your HubSpot CRM data — contacts, deals, engagements, and more.
The contacts endpoints allow you to create and manage contact records in your HubSpot account
